most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis triggered by visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar)
one_line_reason: The patient meets 5 HLH-2004 criteria: fever, splenomegaly, low hemoglobin plus low neutrophils, triglycerides 349 with fibrinogen 107, and ferritin 1144. In a Pakistani child, months of relapsing fever despite broad antibiotics, marked hepatosplenomegaly, hypoalbuminemia, anemia and monocytosis point to visceral leishmaniasis as the trigger.
